Year-on-year inflation in the OECD, as measured by the Consumer Price Index (CPI), rose to 4.5% in September 2026, up from 4.3% in August.

# US Consumer Sentiment Improves in November

The University of Michigan’s consumer sentiment index rose to 51.0 in early November 2026, up from 48.0 in October and comfortably above market expectations of 48.0.

Modest gains across several components, including expectations for personal finances and business conditions, were driven primarily by independent voters.
